The horizontal axis has 4 unlabeled tick marks on the positive side and 3 tick marks on the negative side, whereas the vertical axis is unlabeled. The first curve enters from the bottom left of the viewing window in the third quadrant, slopes upward steeply to the right, concave down increasing to the right, cuts the negative side of the vertical axis around a point close to the origin, to enter the fourth quadrant, the curve inflects,, slopes downward to the right, concave up, slopes upward steeply to the right, cuts the positive side of the horizontal axis around a point between the third and the fourth tick marks to enter the first quadrant and continues to slope upward to exit the first quadrant at the top right of the viewing window. The second curve enters from the bottom left of the viewing window above the first curve in the third quadrant, the curve slopes upward to the right, cuts the first curve, slopes upward to the right, cuts the negative side of the vertical axis little below the point of first curve to enter the fourth quadrant, thereafter the curve slopes upward to the right, intersects the first curve again close to the positive side of the horizontal axis, slopes upward to the right, reaches its maximum peak at a point just below the second tick mark in the positive side of the horizontal axis, further the curve slopes downward, cuts the first curve to and continues to slope upward to exit the first quadrant at the bottom right of the viewing window.

Details Two curves are graphed in a coordinate plane. The horizontal axis has 2 unlabeled tick marks on the positive side and 2 tick marks on the negative side. The vertical axis has 8 unlabeled tick marks on the positive side and 5 unlabeled tick marks on the negative side. The first curve enters from the left of the viewing window in the third quadrant, slopes upward to the right gradually, cuts the negative side of the vertical axis at the second tick mark to enter the fourth quadrant, further the curve slopes upward, concave up, cuts the positive side of the horizontal axis between the origin and the first tick mark, continues to slopes upward steeply to the right and exits at the top right of the viewing window. The second curve enters from the bottom left of the viewing window in the third quadrant, slopes upward to the right steeply, cuts the negative side of the horizontal axis at a point close to the first tick mark on its right to enter the second quadrant, further the curve slopes upward to the right, inflects close to the vertical axis and cuts the positive side of the vertical axis at the fifth tick mark to enter the first quadrant. Thereafter the curve plateaus in the first quadrant to intersect the first curve, continues to slope upward to the right and exits at the top right of the viewing window on the right of the first curve.

Details Two curves are graphed in a coordinate plane. The horizontal axis has 6 unlabeled tick marks on the positive side. The vertical axis has 1unlabeled tick mark on the positive side and 2 unlabeled tick marks on the negative side. The first curve enters the first quadrant through the origin, slopes upward gradually to the right, concave down slopes downward to the right, reaches the fifth tick mark in the horizontal axis, continues to slope along the horizontal axis and exits the first quadrant on the right of the viewing window. The second curve enters the fourth quadrant through the origin, slopes downward to the right, inflects, slopes to the right, concave up increasing to the right, slopes upward to the right, cuts the positive side of the horizontal axis around the fourth tick mark to enter the first quadrant, thereafter the curve slopes up gradually to the right and exits the first quadrant at the top right of the viewing window.

problem.paragraph: Refer to Example 1. Find the area of the larger region that is completely enclosed by the graphs of the functions $$f$$ and $$g$$ .
